items.lede: The Ukrainian military is claiming a world’s first after using an unmanned drone to rescue an injured soldier on the eastern Kharkiv front.
items.title: Ukraine rescues wounded soldier using drone in daring 'world's first' UAV evacuation of a human

items.lede: Ukraine’s latest drone innovation may boost bleak odds of evacuating casualties.
items.title: Ukraine’s drone rescue of wounded soldier puts much touted idea into practice
